factor_interval_provenance.unit: task (896 declared tasks, one historical generation per task)
factor_interval_provenance.IC_tests_method: Wilson score interval for the binary task factor
factor_interval_provenance.IC_proofs_method: percentile bootstrap of the mean per-task proof factor
factor_interval_provenance.bootstrap_rng: numpy.random.default_rng; reset per model, variant and factor
factor_interval_provenance.repetitions: single generation per task; no model calls or compiler reruns
factor_interval_provenance.p_value: n/a; descriptive intervals, no hypothesis test
factor_interval_provenance.limits: Conditional on the recorded historical files and transformations; does not cover transformation validity, between-generation variability or judge uncertainty.
